items.heading: Adana Kebab
details: Key ingredients: minced lamb, red pepper, garlic, chili flakes, sumac
Mix minced lamb with grated onion, garlic, chili flakes and salt.
Mold the mixture onto flat skewers.
Grill over hot coals, turning until charred and cooked through.
Serve with grilled peppers, flatbread and a sprinkle of sumac.

items.heading: Turkish Delight
details: Key ingredients: sugar, cornstarch, water, lemon juice, rosewater, powdered sugar
Boil sugar and water into a syrup, then whisk in a cornstarch slurry.
Cook slowly, stirring often, until thick and glossy.
Stir in rosewater and lemon juice, then pour into a tray to set.
Once firm, cut into cubes and dust generously with powdered sugar.

items.heading: Menemen
details: Key ingredients: eggs, tomato, green pepper, onion, butter
Saute chopped onion and green pepper in butter until soft.
Add diced tomato and cook until it breaks down into a sauce.
Crack in eggs and stir gently until softly scrambled.
Serve hot with crusty bread.

items.heading: Kebab
details: Ingredients: meat or vegetables, yogurt/oil, garlic, spices, salt and lemon.
